topic: A teacher receives an unexpected gift from a former student
text: I tell ye, the world can be a queer place. Master Elias, he that taught the youngins, got a gift today. Came in a simple box, wrapped not by rough hands but by ones knowin' fancy work. The village whispers, sayin' it was from one of his old students, gone to the cities to find wealth and fine livin'. But I can see in his eyes, the same unease that stirred my heart when the storm clouds gather too soon or the soil turns dry. He’s got that look, the one that comes when you’re not sure what the next day’ll bring, like plantin’ seeds in stony ground. I reckon, it’s not the gift that troubles him, but what it might mean, or what it might take away.
